verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test mode, or separate non-production environment for Airweave. Local self-hosting (docs-14, docs-31) is an alternative way to deploy the product, not an isolated test environment the product provides, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: any documented sandbox, test environment, or mechanism isolating test activity from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
